messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The platform lacks the ability to map existing sign-on groups directly to claim roles, forcing manual permission assignments.
  quote: when assigning staff to different claim roles, we can’t seem to map our existing sign-on groups to those roles directly... right now that mapping isn’t available, and it’s causing extra manual work for our team.
- problem: The user is unable to assign roles to new staff members while updating team access levels.
  quote: I’m trying to update our team’s access levels and I’m stuck on assigning roles for new staff.
- problem: The user suspects a configuration error is preventing them from having the correct role permissions.
  quote: I’m under the impression I’m assigned the right role, but maybe something’s misconfigured on our end.
